title: [ingest] Onboarding harness is only trustworthy when cold-rate is strictly in (0,1)
summary: onboard-harness.js reports DEGENERATE/not-trustworthy if the cold (no-KB) agent passes everything or fails everything — a trustworthy reading needs cold passing the control probes and failing the project-specific ones. It also requires cold_rate_control >= 0.5. This guard exists because an earlier harness gave a circular 0%->100% reading graded against the notes' own tokens.
